text:
maya: Heads-up — I'm hitting weird import + auth issues when consuming the Node/TS SDK in a Next 13 edge route and also in a Vite serverless build. Anyone seen minorly different behavior between dev vs prod bundles?

sam: Which issue? import failures or runtime missing globals?

maya: ImportError in local dev: "Cannot use import statement outside a module" when requiring the lib from a CJS test. In the edge route I get "ReadableStream is not defined" when streaming. Also auth: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY isn't making it to the edge runtime.

jon: For the import problem we published a "dual" entrypoint using conditional exports. package.json example:

```
"exports": {
  "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
  "require": "./dist/index.cjs"
}
```

That keeps ESM for modern bundlers and CJS for old require consumers.

lina: For Next edge, env vars prefixed NEXT_PUBLIC are exposed to client — don't do that. Edge functions (Vercel) don't have process.env like Node; use secret manager or middleware and pass short-lived tokens. Also RW SDK should provide a fetch-based auth flow for edge.

maya: Any quick patch for ReadableStream issue? We need to stream tokens to the browser from edge.

sam: Edge uses Web Streams. In Node serverless you might get Node's stream.Readable. SDK can expose both. Quick workaround in edge: wrap Node stream with response.body via new Response(stream).body won't work. Instead use the SDK's createWebStream helper or convert:

```
const webStream = new ReadableStream({
  start(controller) { /* push chunks */ }
})
return new Response(webStream)
```

If SDK returns a Node stream, pipeToWeb method helps — we added utils/streamToWeb in latest beta.

maya: Ah ok. Where's streamToWeb? Is that in 0.9.1-beta?

jon: It's in beta. Use `import { streamToWeb } from '@redwood-inference/sdk/compat'` or just upgrade to 0.9.1-beta.1 — we plan to backport a smaller shim for stable.

lina: Auth note — don't embed the API key in edge client. On Vercel Edge you can store in Secrets and call a serverless function to mint ephemeral tokens. We added an example in docs/dev/edge-auth.md (link).

maya: Cool. Final thing: bundlers (Vite) are tree-shaking the exports and break conditional exports sometimes. Any config to add?

sam: For Vite set optimizeDeps.include to force pre-bundling of the SDK, or set ssr: { external: [] } depending on the target. Example:

```
// vite.config.js
optimizeDeps: { include: ['@redwood-inference/sdk'] },
ssr: { external: ['some-legacy-dep'] }
```

Also ensure package.json has "module" and "main" fields filled.

maya: Nice. One more: retries and idempotency. Edge retries are causing duplicate side-effects in our webhook tests.

jon: Add idempotency-key header from client, server should dedupe. Also use idempotent id for GET-like or for operations with safe retries.

maya: Thanks all, will upgrade to beta and try streamToWeb + conditional exports. Ping me if you spot any regressions. :pray:
